concerns.text: T109 ('confirm all pytest and schema validations pass' on a clean re-run) declares 'Dependency: T101–T104, T107' but omits T103, which wires tradeoff_curve.csv schema validation into code/main.py. The reproducibility re-run therefore executes before the CSV-validation producer is integrated, so the re-run cannot exercise the validation T103 adds — a consumer-before-producer gap. Add T103 to T109's dependency list.

T105 (adaptive sampling) is ordered in the parallel band but no downstream task consumes it: T108's results and T109's re-run use the base T101 pipeline. If adaptive sampling is intended to refine the published threshold (plan Phase 10/3 'adaptive sampling densifies near expected inflection'), either T108/T109 should depend on a re-run with --adaptive, or state explicitly that T105 is an optional extension not feeding the published artifacts.
